en: A vintage map-style postcard showing a colored street plan of a fortified town laid out in a grid, with red blocks for buildings and white streets. On the right, a blue cartouche contains French and Greek text identifying it as a plan of the town of Missolonghi in Greece. Decorative green elements appear on the left border. At the bottom, there is a printer's credit in both Latin and Greek scripts and a serial number.
